title: After Plunging 40% This Year, XPeng Bets on Physical AI to Help Turn the Tide
excerpt: XPeng's stock is trading near 52-week lows. Can physical AI help XPEV stock recover?
content_html:
Mohit Oberoi

Wed, August 12, 2026 at 7:59 AM PDT 4 min read

Things haven't been pleasant for investors in Chinese electric vehicle (EV) companies this year. Among the emerging new energy vehicle (NEV) companies, XPeng's (XPEV) stock is down over 41% for the year, which is far worse than rivals Nio (NIO) and Li Auto (LI). In my previous article, I noted that XPEV was attractive near its 52-week lows. It has, however, continued its downward trajectory and is now trading at new 52-week lows. Let's examine whether XPEV can recover in 2026 or if it's time to give up on this underperforming stock.

Chinese Auto Market Is Witnessing Degrowth

The Chinese auto market is experiencing degrowth, with sales falling for 10 consecutive months. In the first seven months of this year, domestic passenger sales in the world's biggest auto market shrunk by over a fifth. Sales of internal combustion engine (ICE) cars have been particularly weak. While new energy vehicle (NEV) penetration in the country rose to almost 65% in July, a record high, sales have fallen in all seven months this year.

Specifically, XPeng's deliveries in the first seven months of the year fell by nearly 13% compared to the corresponding period last year. The company's monthly deliveries peaked above 42,000 vehicles in October 2025 and have since failed to breach that high bar. Its deliveries have failed to take off materially, and the average monthly deliveries in the first seven months of the year are below 30,000. Nio has fared much better and sold more cars than XPEV in the first seven months. Unsurprisingly, its stock has performed better even though it too is in the red.

Meanwhile, XPeng is pivoting to physical artificial intelligence (AI), which is arguably the buzzword these days, and changed its name from XPeng Motors to XPeng Group earlier this year. We have similar stories in the U.S., where Lucid Motors and Tesla Motors previously dropped "Motors" from their names and are known as Lucid Group (LCID) and Tesla (TSLA), respectively. The name changes were meant to reflect their ambitions beyond the automotive industry. Remember, even Facebook renamed itself Meta Platforms (META). It's a different thing altogether that the metaverse, which prompted the name change, has turned out to be a vanity project.

莫希特·奥贝罗伊

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 8 月 12 日星期三上午 7:59 阅读 4 分钟

今年，中国电动汽车（EV）公司的投资者的日子并不好过。 在新兴新能源汽车（NEV）公司中，小鹏汽车（XPEV）股价今年以来下跌超过41%，跌幅远逊于竞争对手蔚来汽车（NIO）和理想汽车（LI）。 在我之前的文章中，我指出 XPEV 在 52 周低点附近具有吸引力。 然而，它继续下跌，目前交易价格创 52 周新低。 让我们来看看 XPEV 能否在 2026 年复苏，或者是否是时候放弃这只表现不佳的股票了。

中国汽车市场正在经历衰退

中国汽车市场正经历衰退，销量连续10个月下降。 今年前七个月，这个全球最大汽车市场的国内客运销量萎缩了五分之一以上。 内燃机（ICE）汽车的销售尤其疲软。 虽然7月份中国新能源汽车(NEV)渗透率升至近65%，创历史新高，但今年七个月销量均出现下滑。

具体来说，小鹏汽车今年前7个月的交付量较去年同期下降了近13%。 该公司的月交付量在 2025 年 10 月达到了 42,000 辆以上的峰值，此后一直未能突破这一高标准。 其交付量未能大幅增长，今年前7个月的月均交付量不足3万辆。 前七个月，蔚来的表现比 XPEV 好得多，销量也多于 XPEV。 毫不奇怪，尽管它的股票也出现亏损，但它的股票表现却更好。

与此同时，小鹏汽车正在转向物理人工智能（AI），这可以说是当今的流行词，并于今年早些时候将公司名称从小鹏汽车更名为小鹏集团。 我们在美国也有类似的故事，Lucid Motors 和 Tesla Motors 之前从名称中删除了“Motors”，分别称为 Lucid Group (LCID) 和 Tesla (TSLA)。 更名旨在反映他们超越汽车行业的雄心。 请记住，甚至 Facebook 也将自己重新命名为元平台 (META)。 促使更名的虚拟宇宙最终被证明是一个虚荣项目，这完全是另一回事。
